newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Indian students found slain in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Indian students found slain in Australia.

text.p: Two Indian students have been found dead in bushland in the northern Australian city of Brisbane, police said on Saturday.
The bodies of the 22-year-old woman and her 21-year-old brother were found on Friday wrapped in plastic bags in Brisbane's western suburbs, police told Reuters.
An autopsy was due to be carried out on Saturday and the case was being treated as murder, police said.
The victims' names were not being released until relatives had been notified.
Their Singaporean flatmate, Rhaajesh Subramaniam, a 26-year-old engineering student, appeared in a Brisbane court on Saturday charged with four counts of forgery.
Police would not give further details.
But the domestic newsagency, Australian Associated Press, said the court was told Subramaniam had withdrawn almost A$10,000 (US$7,650) from the victims' bank account.
Subramaniam was refused bail and is being held in custody. He is due to appear in court again on Monday.
